race.description: Walsh Consulting Engineers Mdn C,G&E Hcp
race.comment: MONOTONE (4) debuts for the in-form Jack Bruce camp and has trialled like a bomb in readiness. He showed glimpses of ability in NSW without putting it all together. Chased Aethelwulf into second when last sighted raceday, with good gaps through the rest. Thompson's booking is a big push and if he convert his trial form he looks very hard to beat. NO WALLET REG (15) is race-fit and was only beaten a head at Beaudesert last week, with his Ipswich run prior also competitive. BETTY'S BOY (11) only warmed late on debut here two weeks ago when closing off well to grab third behind what looks a smart winner. Better for that and can give this a shake. JUNGLE WONDER (6) has been leaving himself with too much to do but finishing off strongly. Gets a key booking in Maloney and if he can settle him closer he can play a major role.
